insights.summary: Per a concall.in summary (4 Nov 2026), BSE's H1 FY27 revenue rose 49% to ₹3,257 Cr, operating EBITDA 55% to ₹2,019 Cr (67% margin) and net profit 53% to ₹1,680 Cr. Q2 index-options premium ADTV fell to ₹22,531 Cr from ₹29,615 Cr in Q1 (the first quarterly decline) but October hit a record ₹35,481 Cr. Management called the 67-68% margin sustainable.
